task.title: How to reset auto reverse user settings

context.p: To change the rearview mirror automatic control functions back to their factory default settings, follow these steps:

step.cmd: Set the shift lever to P (Park). Make sure that the vehicle is stopped and the mirror is not working.
Position the lever to L (left) or R (right) according to the mirror you want to adjust.
Engage the brake pedal and set the shift lever to R (Reverse).
When the rearview mirror finishes moving downward, press the ▲ (up) switch to move the mirror’s position higher (P, N, or D). Adjust the mirror higher than its driving mode position.

To initialize auto reverse user settings, shift the gear out of R (Reverse), or change the rearview mirror selector lever to its neutral position. The initialized position will be applied in the next operation.
Follow the same procedure to initialize settings for the rearview mirror on the other side of the vehicle.

note.p: Kia recommends following the above procedures in order when changing or initializing auto reverse user settings. If you move to the next step before completing the previous 1, the angle may not change or initialization may not work properly.
